papers.title: Investigation of the selective laser melting process with molybdenum powder
papers.first_author_affiliation: Central Institute of Engineering, Electronics and Analytics, Forschungszentrum Jülich GmbH, 52425 Jülich, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: D. Faidel
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Central Institute of Engineering, Electronics and Analytics, Forschungszentrum Jülich GmbH, 52425 Jülich, Germany

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究钼粉末的选择性激光熔化工艺，未涉及生物医学植入物或骨科力学匹配。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on LPBF of molybdenum for non-biomedical applications, with no discussion of porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究钼粉末的SLM工艺参数对成型质量的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过实验设计改变激光功率、扫描速度等参数并分析致密度
summary_zh.result: 获得了高致密度钼零件的优化工艺窗口
summary_zh.validation: 使用金相显微镜和密度测量验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of selective laser melting process parameters on the densification of molybdenum powder.
summary_en.method: Systematic variation of laser power and scanning speed with subsequent density and microstructure characterization.
summary_en.result: Optimized process parameters yielding high-density molybdenum parts were identified.
summary_en.validation: Validation via optical microscopy and Archimedes density measurements.

papers.title: Selective laser melting of boron carbide particles coated by a cobalt-based metal layer
papers.first_author_affiliation: Lyon University, ENISE, LTDS Laboratory, Saint Etienne, France

corresponding_authors.name: A. Sova
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Lyon University, ENISE, LTDS Laboratory, Saint Etienne, France

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究碳化硼颗粒钴基涂层的激光选区熔化，完全不涉及生物医学植入物、应力遮挡或多孔结构。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on ceramic-metal composite coatings for wear resistance, with no porous structures, stress shielding analysis, fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高钴基涂层的耐磨性
summary_zh.method: 对碳化硼颗粒包覆钴合金后进行SLM熔覆
summary_zh.result: 成功制备出高硬度的复合涂层
summary_zh.validation: 显微组织和显微硬度测试

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the wear resistance of cobalt-based coatings by incorporating boron carbide particles.
summary_en.method: Boron carbide particles were coated with a cobalt-based metal layer and selectively laser melted.
summary_en.result: A composite coating with high hardness and good metallurgical bonding was achieved.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural analysis and microhardness testing were performed.
